name: payperfax
description: Check the delivery status of a fax sent with PayPerFax, by its tracking ID or tracking link.

interface.shortDescription: Track the delivery of a fax
interface.longDescription:
Check where a fax sent with PayPerFax is, and whether it arrived.

Give the tracking ID or the tracking link of the fax. PayPerFax returns its status: pending (being prepared or on its way), delivered, failed (not delivered), or expired. For a delivered fax, the answer can include when it was sent and how many pages went through.

This is the same tracking that the PayPerFax browser extension uses.

Limitations: this plugin only reads the status of an existing fax. It does not send faxes, change them or cancel them. It checks when you ask and does not watch a fax in the background. A fax that you did not send with PayPerFax cannot be tracked.
defaultPrompt: Check the status of my fax from its tracking link.
Why did my fax fail to go through?

positive.description: Delivered fax, looked up by tracking ID
positive.prompt: Did my fax arrive? The tracking ID is 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that the fax was delivered, with the time it was sent and the number of pages sent.

positive.description: Failed fax, looked up by tracking ID
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that the fax failed and was not delivered, with the reason the status gives.
Reports that the fax is pending and not yet delivered. Does not check again on its own.

positive.description: Lookup by tracking link instead of bare ID
positive.expected_behavior: Takes the ID from the link and reports the same delivered status as the lookup by ID.
Reports that no fax has this ID and asks the user to check the tracking ID or link.

negative.description: Sending a fax is out of scope
Continuous monitoring is out of scope
negative.prompt: Keep checking fax 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003 every minute and tell me when it is delivered.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments. It only reads the delivery status of an existing fax.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: check the delivery status of a PayPerFax fax by tracking ID or tracking link.
